facts.claim: The Supreme Government decided that the Coorg refugees should not be restored to Vfrardja.
facts.quote: The Supreme Government decided under the 18th January 1833, that the Coorg refugees should not be restored to Vfrardja.

facts.claim: A man from the north of Coorg reported that Vfrardja shot at Ndrdyana Ndyaka with a blunt arrow and then a sharp arrow that killed him.
facts.quote: A man from the north of Coorg deposed: that he saw Vfrardja, on a hunting excursion, shooting atNdrdyana Ndyaka, Hobliddra, first with blunt arrows, then with a sharp arrow which killed him, in presence of all his retinue.

facts.claim: Many people, including Coorgs and slaves, were killed, mutilated, starved, or imprisoned for assisting Channa Basava in his escape.
facts.quote: Besides, numbers of people, men and women, Coorgs and slaves, relatives of the Rdjah's family and others, ivho were believed to have been privy to the plans of Channa Basava, or to have assisted him in his escape, were killed, or mutilated, or starved to death, or thrown into prison.
